card.name: Linking words before ethical values
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, against, for, with, and, natural) that come right before an abstract value or protected thing such as freedom, humanity, honesty, or resources. Found in statements about ethics, rights, and the environment.

modes.label: Belief and conduct links
modes.description: A preposition after a belief, crime, or care word, before a value like freedom, humanity, or honesty.
modes.example: will not force us to compromise our belief <<in>> freedom, justice and the rule of law

modes.label: Environment and rights phrases
modes.description: A word inside a phrase naming natural resources or human rights bodies, just before the next noun.
modes.example: efficient use of materials helps conserve<< natural>> resources.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for virtue and sincerity, such as honesty, integrity, humility, and sincere.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a noble value such as freedom, honesty, or humanity.
